div.h1: Premium Pakistani Mangoes, Straight from Our Orchard.
div.p: Chaunsa, Sindhri, Anwar Ratol and Langra mangoes, grown by the Ghulam Hussain family in the fertile plains of southern Punjab and picked at the right stage.
Our Mangoes
div.h2: Pakistani Mango Varieties from Our Orchard

div.p: Very sweet, smooth and fiberless. The best-loved mango of the Pakistani summer.
Large, golden and fragrant, with smooth, fiberless flesh. Great for gifting.

img.alt: Anwar Ratol mango, small and very aromatic

div.p: Small in size, big in aroma. Very sweet, rich and soft.
Green-skinned, juicy and tangy-sweet. A traditional favourite.
Our Orchard
div.h2: A Family Mango Farm in Alipur, Punjab
div.p: Ghulam Hussain Farms sits on the fertile plains near Head Panjnad, in Tehsil Alipur, District Muzaffargarh. Hot summers and rich river soil give our mangoes their sweetness and aroma.
Ghulam Hussain built this orchard from scratch, planting the first saplings himself. Today our family still looks after every tree by hand.

img.alt: Hand-picking a ripe mango at Ghulam Hussain Farms, Alipur
